notes.title: Just Date Goth announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It’s finally time to reveal our new game.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3823730/Just_Date_Goth/"][/dynamiclink]

Just Date Goth is the next installment in our dating sim series, this time even cooler with irresistibly attractive goth girls!

Unlike the previous games, you’ll now be able to explore different locations, take on real jobs, and unlock intimate scenes. All while enjoying every detail through a unique art style and expressive animations.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097120/3a810a3627be158614168441fa03354d007f8a69.gif"]


Game features: 
🔥 Sexy Girls
🎥 Hot Animations
🖱 Point & Click Exploration
🛠 Real-Life Inspired Minigames
♥️ Interesting Story


Add the game to your wishlist now!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3823730/Just_Date_Goth/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Just Date is here!
notes.content:
🍓Today marks a special day for us as we release our debut game, "Just Date". This is our first venture into the gaming world, and we're thrilled to share this romantic adventure with you.🍓

🍉As newcomers in the field, we acknowledge that there might be some hiccups along the way. If you come across any bugs or have suggestions for improvement, we welcome your feedback. Your insights are crucial in shaping the future of "Just Date", and we're eager to learn and grow with your help.🍉

🍆Looking ahead, we plan to actively participate in Steam events and are excited about the prospect of building a dedicated indie dev team. Your support is the driving force behind our journey, and we invite you to connect with us on our socials to stay updated.🍆


 🐦 Twitter
 🤖 Discord

🍑Thank you for being part of our story. Your support is invaluable as we embark on this exciting adventure in the world of gaming and love.🍑
